2 أهّبهُ لِلْأَمْرِ , [inf. n. تَأْهِيبٌ,] He furnished, prepared, equipped, or accoutred, him, for the thing, or affair; he furnished him, or provided him, with the apparatus, gear, tackling, implements, instruments, tools, or the like, proper, or necessary, for it. (MF.) ―
-b2- أهّب الأَمْرَ He prepared the thing, or affair. (MF.) ―
-b3- See also 5.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
